g.text: skip the resource, write no status
[the Secret is absent, a key is missing, or RBAC denies the read]
or answers 200 without a required field]
copy the answer into the status
(spec: adapterAddress, Secret: credentials, probe: the rest,
[the address or the identifier conflicts with the stored registration]
the first database of the type is flagged global)
[the registration is locked by a running migration]
update the row when a property differs,
On 202 the operator does not read the body.
It repeats the registration with the poll backoff
(5 s doubling to 1 min) until the aggregator answers 200.
